item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"Creates a `dspy.Predict(\"question -> answer\")` program and launches several `program.acall(question=...)` coroutines that are awaited together in a single `asyncio.gather(...)` call.","span_ids":["e5","e1","e7"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"Uses an offline `DummyLM` variant whose `aforward` awaits an `asyncio.sleep(...)` delay before delegating to DummyLM's normal generation path, so each request has real async latency without external I/O.","span_ids":["e4","e6"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Seeds the dummy LM with deterministic input-to-output mappings and verifies the gathered predictions by reading each result's `.answer` field against the expected answers.","span_ids":["e3","e4","e8"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"Measures wall-clock time around only the gathered batch and asserts the elapsed time is materially below the serial sum of the injected per-call sleeps, using that bound as proof that the async calls overlapped rather than serialized.","span_ids":["e2","e6","e7"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":132,"end_line":136},{"span_id":"e2","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":257,"end_line":268},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/utils/dummies.py","start_line":69,"end_line":80},{"span_id":"e4","path":"dspy/utils/dummies.py","start_line":122,"end_line":150},{"span_id":"e5","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":771,"end_line":773},{"span_id":"e6","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":774,"end_line":780},{"span_id":"e7","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":790,"end_line":796},{"span_id":"e8","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":797,"end_line":802}]}
